# Exact-pin public C APIv2 / internal authority audit

## Conclusion

At DuckDB `d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa`, **no existing public C APIv2 hook supplies a complete attachment inventory, including HIDDEN, to our extension callback**. The selected no-extra-database contract remains unresolved by public-ABI-only hardening. An actual internal bounded collection operation exists; using it requires an explicitly new pinned C++ bridge or host accessor, not an opaque-handle trick. No design, contract change, implementation or execution is authorized by this report.

## Public surface: complete source inventory, limited capabilities

The complete v2 header declares **620 distinct functions**, exactly matching **620 extension-vtable slots**. `PUBLIC-SURFACE-INVENTORY.json` records all identifiers and both line positions, not source bodies. All 28 primary files (including a V1 cross-check) have independently recomputed SHA256/Git-blob-SHA1; every returned blob SHA matches. Bodies were held only in tool memory. Source availability is not a runtime symbol/load proof. [Public header](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h), [vtable](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_extension_v2.h).

- **Callback context:** borrowed within a DuckDB-managed scope, with a transaction active. Direct API consumers expose config, factory, filesystem and logging, plus Arrow conversion. No public context-to-connection/instance/ClientContext conversion, attachment scan or general SQL authorizer exists in that surface. Actual statement APIs require a connection; extension-input prose mentioning queries is not an accessor. The pointer-shaped opaque declaration does not promise the private wrapper layout. [Header344–352](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L344-L352).
- **A real but partial public alternative:** a new helper could read effective named settings through `context_get_config` and `config_get_option_value`, bypassing SQL callable lookup for those reads. Implementation reads the real current context's native settings cascade. `schema` returns its default schema and `search_path` its explicitly set paths. Neither enumerates attachments or independently proves every lookup authority. Such a helper still needs new extension code/artifact, trusted binding and fresh non-folded execution; none was written. [Config82–101](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_config.cpp#L82-L101), [native settings read382–397](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2.cpp#L382-L397), [setting getters1556–1579](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/settings/custom_settings.cpp#L1556-L1579).
- **Table descriptions:** the whole v2 catalog module provides a named base-table snapshot and its qname/column facts, not a database scan. `connection_describe_table` requires a genuine connection, obeys normal partial-name/search-path/two-part ambiguity rules, and does not enumerate all constraints, callables, types or databases. Its snapshot does not refresh later DDL. Our callback has no public way to extract the needed connection. V1 catalog APIs likewise resolve known catalog/entry names, not every attachment. [Catalog module5899–6149](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L5899-L6149), [lookup13–40](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_catalog.cpp#L13-L40), [V1 named lookup80–136](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v1/catalog-c.cpp#L80-L136).
- **False friends:** instance attach/detach/set-default operate on specified names; environment instance count counts instances; config enumeration lists settings. `duckdb_approx_database_count()` reads a shared file-path-map size. In-memory databases are excluded from that map, so it is not even a conservative detector for hidden memory extras. Calling filtered metadata through another API does not remove its filtering. [Approx count21–24](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/function/table/system/duckdb_approx_database_count.cpp#L21-L24), [path-map15–26](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/database_file_path_manager.cpp#L15-L26).

## Genuine internal path and cap4 meaning

The scalar execution adapter constructs `CV2CallbackContext` from the executing `ExpressionState`'s actual context, then passes its private converted handle to the callback. Internal `CV2Context` stores that `ClientContext&`; the actual private `capiv2::Convert` recovers the wrapper. A deliberately pinned new internal C++ translation unit could use those private definitions to reach the real context. This is **not a public accessor**: do not interpret `ctx->internal_ptr` as ClientContext, cast context to connection, retain the borrowed wrapper, or substitute another database's connection. If a separately built internal wrapper is not viable, a host-owned accessor/patch is required. [Real adapter201–227](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_func_scalar.cpp#L201-L227), [private context404–442 / conversion456–478](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb/main/capi_v2/capi_v2_internal.hpp#L404-L478).

`DatabaseManager::GetDatabases(context, max_db_count)` is a real **internal C++** declaration. The implementation locks `databases_lock`, copies current manager-map attachments without an IsHidden filter, then adds system and this context's temp database. Uncapped, it collects the full current set. The header's older catalog-set/transaction wording is not evidence that the current map implementation provides an MVCC snapshot. [Declaration97–104](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb/main/database_manager.hpp#L97-L104), [actual implementation542–573](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/database_manager.cpp#L542-L573).

**Cap4 is bounded cardinality admission, not full-name enumeration.** Count starts at2 for system/temp; at most2 manager entries are copied. For D manager attachments, returned cardinality is `min(D,2)+2`:3 iff D=1;4 if D>=2. A guard must additionally verify the sole attachment is the expected owned database/name/path/identity and system/temp are expected. Rejected sets with many attachments are deliberately not fully named. The bound is inferred from the source algorithm, not a measured latency/allocation result.

The collection lock ends on return. Shared pointers preserve object lifetime, not future attachment-set membership. Same connection/transaction alone does not prove exclusion of later shared-instance ATTACH/DETACH/rename/default mutation. A selected design must establish exclusive mutation ownership across admission and use, or an appropriate synchronization/authority mechanism; no cached permission follows from an earlier collection. This is a design proof obligation, not a newly observed concurrent failure. [Collection546–560](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/database_manager.cpp#L546-L560), [rename/detach356–414](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/database_manager.cpp#L356-L414).

## Finite options and viability gates

1. **Existing public C APIv2 only:** settings/known-name attestation is partial hardening, not satisfaction of the original complete no-extra-DB contract. No drop-in full solution was found. Visible metadata and restricted external access cannot be silently redefined as that proof.
2. **New pinned internal component, predominantly v2 artifact:** source-plausible, not proved loadable against the shipped wheel. The loader maps `C_STRUCT_UNSTABLE` to the genuine v2 entrypoint. Keeping that entrypoint while adding a deliberately internal component is not source-forbidden, but makes the artifact mixed/private-ABI, not public-C-API-only or portable. Metadata/get_api do not attest C++ layout/symbol compatibility. It needs a new artifact/hash and an honest private dependency boundary; existing260b does not gain a capability through research. [Loader27–36 /830–846](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/extension/extension_load.cpp#L830-L846), [ABI metadata30–40](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb/main/extension.hpp#L30-L40).
3. **Narrow host-owned accessor/static integration:** if the exact wheel lacks compatible internal symbols/layout, add the accessor in the host or rebuild a matching host/extension pair. This is a new host/build surface, not an already available C APIv2 function. A second embedded engine/fresh instance or Python mock cannot attest the existing connection.

Before option2/3 is selected: establish exact internal/generated headers and feature definitions; compiler/stdlib ABI, layout, RTTI/exceptions and platform agreement; actual required host symbol exports/visibility/load-namespace resolution; no second-engine/ODR copy; correct callback/context lifetime; safe shared-pointer destruction and exception-to-C-error handling; genuine v2 entrypoint/metadata/API initialization; and the ownership/snapshot conditions above. `DatabaseManager::Get` / `GetDatabases` are not vtable slots and their declarations lack individual export annotations. Source presence alone does not prove a target wheel exports them. No binary/symbol inspection, compile/link/load or runtime experiment occurred here; root assigned separate static feasibility work. [Manager33–43](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb/main/database_manager.hpp#L33-L43), [library open689 / symbol lookup832–834](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/extension/extension_load.cpp#L830-L846).

A future guard also needs trusted unshadowable binding, fresh non-folded execution before clock/data/parser routes, exact result checking and admission errors propagated without native fallback/retry. Python owner's binder/default-table/type/MVCC authority work is a separate necessary input; no unproven type-shadow hypothesis is asserted here. Owned lookup authority does not silently relax the selected absence-of-extra-attachments requirement.

## Actual checks / closure

Primary retrieval, own hashing, complete declaration/vtable comparison, stdlib JSON/receipt checks and a pure integer cap4 model only. The mathematical model is not a DuckDB query/test. Two initial web header opens ended in cache misses; exact source reads then used GitHub's read connector. One own metadata patch was rejected before application and logged; no file was deleted. No full third-party cache, app source, stopped backup content or platform/session dumps is retained. No reviewed imports, app/DB/native execution, timers, builds, benchmarks, cleanup, remote writes, backup action or selected-contract change occurred. **All ABI/build/load/runtime viability gates remain UNRUN.** Root alone selects and authorizes later work.
